This is going to sound weird if not a bit odd, but I can only described the incident as missing time. When I was in my early 20's I took a shower one evening. My habit is the shampoo my head and immediately was the suds out of my hair. I did the same thing on this occasion, I lathered my hair with the shampoo and immediately put my head under the shower head with more than enough time to wash out all of the suds. I was fully expecting all of the shampoo to be gone from the top of my head but when I put my hands on top of my head it was as if I had ran no water on top of it at all. The head was full of the shampoo that I had just washed away.

This startled me. I pulled the shower curtain back to see no one pranking me and wondered what had just happened. How did I lose this time? Did I simply forget, because I remember this so vividly I can't believe that I would forget that I hadn't washed out the suds. And since this startled me, I can't believe that it wasn't real.
Has anyone else experienced missing time?
